title: SteamRot Test Data Configuration Schema
description: JSON schema for test data configurations used in data-driven testing

test_suite.description: Name of the test suite (e.g., component name, feature name)

description.description: Description of what this test suite validates

name.description: Unique name for this test case

description.description: Description of what this test case validates

tags.description: Tags for categorizing test cases (e.g., edge_case, happy_path, error_case)

input.description: Input data for the test case (structure depends on what is being tested)

expected.description: Expected output or state after processing input

should_fail.description: If true, this test case expects the operation to fail
